title: Spastic scoring reads the last neighbour extra value rather than the candidate value

reported_sources.text:
`borg_flow_spastic()`: the value `v` subtracts `ag->xtra * 40`, but
  `ag` was reused by the neighbour loops and points at the last one
  (`ag_ptr[7]`, the north-west grid), not at the candidate grid.

next_at_import: Check current C and both ports, duplicate-search the exact symptom, then reproduce a legal scenario with controls before a local proposal. No C submission.
